correctness.rationale: The private-neighbor characterization is equivalent to nonremovability for all dominating sets. The five-bit local transition checks each actual center exactly once with both boundary exclusions. Induction on support-prefix length proves the 64-state subset-family determinization represents all \(2^k\) support labelings exactly. All 206 BFS reachable states and transitions are constructed, with 140 accepting and 79 rejecting edges. The max-plus vector recurrence is exact, and the equality \(w_{21}=w_{16}+2\) holds on all 206 states (and again at \(n=17,\ldots,20\)), so induction yields \(w_{n+5}=w_n+2\) for all \(n\ge16\). Exact bases \(n=0,\ldots,20\) yield \(\lfloor(2n+2)/5\rfloor\). An independent direct mask-enumeration and literal-deletion implementation checks all shattered-support coefficients for \(n=0,\ldots,13\). Reproducible graph digest 745e40a73b2b4c98aa3dee965bd42ffe216cefd75c1ccb361d3d905f7650bd1d. Boundaries \(n=0,1,2\) included. All-n proof is a finite certificate plus induction, not a extrapolation of finitely many examples.

value.rationale: All inclusion-minimal dominating sets are a canonical graph-solution/monotone-transversal dual family, whose shattering complexity matters for learning minimal domination witnesses and enumeration geometry. Earlier exact path analysis ended at eleven, so the sharp all-n VC law establishes the asymptotic density \(2/5\), distinct from the maximal independent subfamily density \(1/3\). The full all-coefficient 206-state rational enumerator supplies information not encoded by the scalar VC rank. These are infinite all-parameter exact results for a natural object, not a narrow tabulation or a routine reuse of the earlier 11-vertex gap.
